app.name: OWSH Helmet
common.noscript: This app needs JavaScript to be turned on.
common.assistNotReplace: The helmet assists your white cane or guide dog. It never replaces them.
nav.label: Main menu
connect.title: Connect your helmet
connect.intro: Turn on the helmet and keep it close to this phone. Then choose “Connect helmet” and pick the device whose name starts with OWSH.
connect.demoHint: The demo helmet simulates alerts, status and an emergency so you can learn the app without hardware.
connect.emergencySummary: Emergency number: {number} ({country}). You can change it in Settings.
connect.unsupportedTitle: Bluetooth is not available in this browser
connect.unsupported.ios: Safari and every other browser on iPhone and iPad cannot use Web Bluetooth. To connect a real helmet, open this page in the free Bluefy browser app from the App Store. The demo helmet works here.
connect.unsupported.firefox: Firefox does not support Web Bluetooth. Use Chrome or Microsoft Edge on Android, Windows, macOS or ChromeOS. The demo helmet works here.
connect.unsupported.safari: Safari does not support Web Bluetooth. Use Chrome or Microsoft Edge on macOS or Windows. The demo helmet works here.
connect.unsupported.insecure: Bluetooth only works on a secure page, with an address starting with https. Open the app from its https address. The demo helmet works here.
connect.unsupported.other: This browser does not support Web Bluetooth. Use Chrome or Microsoft Edge on Android, Windows, macOS or ChromeOS. The demo helmet works here.
connect.noAdapter: Bluetooth seems to be off or unavailable on this device. Turn Bluetooth on and try again.
connect.error.cancelled: No helmet was chosen. Try again when the helmet is turned on and close by.
connect.error.notOwsh: That device is not an OWSH helmet. Choose a device whose name starts with OWSH.
connect.error.security: The browser blocked Bluetooth. Check that Bluetooth is allowed for this site.
connect.error.generic: Could not connect to the helmet. Make sure it is turned on and close by, then try again. Details: {detail}
connect.error.auth: The helmet refused the connection because this phone is not paired with it. If connection is refused, restart the helmet and connect within 2 minutes.
connect.pairing1: The helmet only accepts phones that are paired with it. The first time you connect, your phone shows a pairing request. Accept it; no code is needed.
connect.pairing2: A new phone can pair while no phone is paired with the helmet, or within 2 minutes after the helmet is turned on.
connect.pairing3: If connection is refused, restart the helmet and connect within 2 minutes.
connect.how1: Turn Bluetooth on. Android may also need Location turned on to find nearby devices.
connect.how2: Only one phone can be connected to the helmet at a time.
connect.how3: If the connection drops, the app keeps trying to reconnect while it is open.
connect.how4: Keep this app open and the screen on. Phones pause web apps when the screen turns off.
live.title: Helmet
status.heading: Helmet status
status.faultWarning: The helmet reports a problem. Warnings from that part may be missing.
status.undervoltageOn: Power is low — charge the battery
status.throttledOn: Helmet is slowing down to cool
status.waiting: Waiting for the first status report…
status.stale: No status report from the helmet for {s} seconds. Do not rely on the helmet until it reports again.
fault.camera_blocked: Camera is covered or too dark
fault.lidar_fwd: Forward distance sensor is not working
fault.lidar_down: Downward step sensor is not working
loc.heading: Location sharing
loc.off: Location sharing is off. The helmet cannot tell you where you are.
loc.notConnected: Location is shared only while the helmet is connected.
loc.waiting: Waiting for a location from the phone…
loc.sharing: Sharing your location with the helmet every 10 seconds.
loc.lastSent: Last sent at {time}, accurate to about {acc} m.
loc.stale: GPS signal lost. The last location is too old to send.
loc.denied: Location permission is blocked. Allow location for this site in your browser settings.
loc.unavailable: Location is not available right now.
loc.needLocationLog: The helmet asked for your location.
loc.sayOff: Location sharing is turned off in the phone app.
loc.sayUnavailable: The phone could not get your location.
loc.sayDenied: Location permission is blocked on the phone.
demo.heading: Demo controls
demo.intro: These buttons make the demo helmet act as if something happened.
demo.cancelSos: Simulate helmet button press (cancels the countdown)
log.heading: Messages from the helmet
log.announce: Read new messages aloud with the screen reader
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Settings are saved only on this phone.
settings.savedPending: Saved. It will be sent to the helmet when it connects.
settings.sentToHelmet: Saved and sent to the helmet.
settings.emergencyNumber: Number to call in an emergency
settings.emergencyHint: Check that this number works where you are. The app never calls by itself.
settings.emergencyOtherCountry: Enter the emergency number for your country. 112 works on mobile phones in many countries, but not everywhere.
country.EU: European Union and most of Europe
country.OTHER: Other country: enter the number yourself
settings.guardiansHint: Up to 3 phone numbers. They are only used when you choose “Send SMS to guardians”.
settings.helmetHint: Changes are sent to the helmet right away when it is connected.
settings.muted: Mute information messages (warnings are always spoken)
settings.dropoff.low: Low: fewer false alarms on dark or wet ground
settings.dropoff.high: High: warns earlier, more false alarms
settings.testVoiceText: This is a test message from your phone.
settings.testVoiceSent: Test message sent to the helmet.
settings.sayTooSoon: Not sent: the helmet accepts one message every 3 seconds. Try again in a moment.
settings.shareLocation: Share my location with the helmet
settings.shareHint: When on and the helmet is connected, the phone sends its location to the helmet every 10 seconds and when you ask “Where am I?”. The location goes only from this phone to your helmet.
settings.geocode: Look up the street address (uses the internet)
settings.geocodeHint: Off by default. When on, your coordinates are sent to the OpenStreetMap Nominatim service, at most once every 30 seconds, to find an address the helmet can speak. The OpenStreetMap Foundation receives these requests and can see where you are. Address data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
settings.keepAwake: Keep the screen on while the helmet is connected
settings.keepAwakeHint: Phones pause web apps when the screen turns off, and then emergency alerts and location sharing stop. Keeping the screen on uses more battery.
sos.reason.button: Reason: the SOS button was held.
sos.countdownHelp: To cancel, press any button on the helmet.
sos.countdownPhoneNote: This phone cannot cancel the countdown. If it is not cancelled, the phone will sound an alarm.
sos.sentLead: The helmet sent an emergency alert. Get help now.
sos.ok: I'm OK, close the emergency screen
sos.cannotAutoCall: A web app cannot call or send messages by itself. Tap a button above, then confirm in your phone app. A person nearby can also help.
sos.locationValue: Latitude {lat}, longitude {lon}, accurate to about {acc} m.
sos.locationUnavailable: Location is not available. Tell the emergency service where you are.
sos.openMap: Open this location on a map
sos.noGuardians: No guardian numbers are set. Your messages app will let you choose a contact.
sos.smsBody: EMERGENCY from an Open Walking Safety Helmet user: {reason} at {time}. {location}
announce.lost: Helmet connection lost. Trying to reconnect.
